payload.title: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit Now Supports Blackwell Architecture
payload.summary: Overview of CUDA Toolkit 12.8 as the first release with full Blackwell support across the developer suite, including profiling tools, libraries, and compilers.

sections.heading: 1. Overview
sections.gist: CUDA Toolkit 12.8 is the **first** version to support NVIDIA Blackwell architecture across the entire developer suite (performance tools, profilers, libraries, compilers).

sections.heading: 2. Blackwell Key Capabilities
sections.gist: - **20.8 billion transistors**, over 2.5x Hopper - Second-generation Transformer Engine + custom Tensor Cores (accelerating LLM/MoE training and inference) - Hardware decompression: LZ4 / Snappy / Deflate - NVLink and NVLink Switches for a…

sections.heading: 3. CUDA Graphs: Runtime Kernel Selection with 2x Speedup
sections.gist: CUDA 12.8 adds two new conditional node types: **IF/ELSE composite nodes** and **SWITCH nodes**.

sections.heading: 4. CUTLASS 3.8 for Blackwell
sections.gist: - GEMM achieves **98%** of peak performance - **Grouped GEMM (common in MoE inference)** FP4 delivers **5x** improvement over H200 FP16 (for DeepSeek-V3, R1 MoE) - New data types: MX narrow precision + NVIDIA FP4

sections.heading: 5. Nsight Compute 2025.1 (First Official Blackwell Support)
sections.gist: - **Tensor Memory visualization in Memory Chart** - Tensor Core performance data surfaced - Range Profiling major improvements: - Source-level metrics within ranges (executed instructions + memory accesses) - Range-guided analysis rule eva…

sections.heading: 6. Math Libraries
sections.gist: - **cuBLAS**: MX 4-bit/8-bit mixed-precision matrix multiplication (CC >= 10.0); preliminary CUDA-in-Graphics (CIG) support for Windows x64 + Ampere/Blackwell GeForce GPUs - cuSOLVER: New `zsytrf/zsytrs` (pivotless complex symmetric direct…

sections.heading: 7. cudaStreamGetDevice and Compiler Updates
sections.gist: - New `cudaStreamGetDevice` simplifies multi-device applications - GCC 14 host compiler support - Blackwell default advanced optimizer based on LLVM 18 - `nvdisasm` supports JSON-format SASS disassembly

sections.heading: 8. Accelerated Python (Beta)
sections.gist: - `cuda.core` early prototype + CUDA bindings moved to `cuda.bindings` - CCCL parallel/cooperative algorithm Python prototypes, enabling thread-level parallelism expression in pure Python - CuPy Blackwell patch validated for full release

sections.heading: 9. Architecture Lifecycle Changes
sections.gist: Maxwell / Pascal / Volta are now considered **feature-complete**.
